title: The radical-fixing Galois subgroup
statement: For fields K⊆E and a family α indexed by positive integers prime to p, tameRadicalKernel(α) is the intersection over d of the stabilizer of α_d in Gal(E/K), with its inherited subgroup topology. No existence theorem or choice is used to define it.

source.place: Tags 0BUA and 0BUB; uniformizer radicals and tame kernel; compare ILO Expose XVII section 1.2, printed page 259.

proof.text: Take the intersection of the actual multiplicative-action stabilizers, a subgroup by the complete lattice of subgroups.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0BUA and 0BUB, with the direct Hensel-unit-root and telescoping specialization of more-algebra.tex Tag 09EE, written in the Lean helper docstrings.
